span.div:
- Lease duration: default 60 seconds
(configurable)
- Master election: 5-15 seconds after failure
- Clients cache lock state locally (read
optimization)
- Cache invalidation via lease expiration or
explicit invalidate
- Fencing tokens: built into the protocol
- Designed for coarse-grained locking (hours,
not milliseconds)
